newsitem.title: UK: VICKERS NOT SEEKING PACT WITH BAE.
newsitem.headline: VICKERS NOT SEEKING PACT WITH BAE.

text.p: The possible sale of Vickers Group Plc's S&W Medico Teknik unit would not lead to a merger with British Aerospace Plc, a source close to Vickers said.

The Independent on Sunday said Vickers was hoping to announce the sale of its medical division when it publishes its half-year results in September. The paper said the move would pave the way to an agreed merger with British Aerospace Plc.
"The sale of the medical is something Vickers has said was under review and the City is expecting a sale. It's one of the key options we're looking at, but it's not a done deal," the source said.
"Speculation about a merger... is frankly out of the stratosphere. It's rubbish," she added.
Vickers routinely declines to comment on market rumours.
